paragraphs: Simon Harris is the Tánaiste, the deputy leader of the Government. He wrote to all political parties in Ireland and Northern Ireland. He asked for their ideas about a united Ireland.
The Social Democrats are the first party in the South to answer in writing. Their leader for now is Cian O'Callaghan. The party has four ideas.
One idea is a new group of politicians in the Oireachtas, the Irish parliament. Members from Northern Ireland could join it. The party also wants the public to give their views.
Other parties gave different answers. Sinn Féin and the SDLP liked the letter. The DUP and the UUP were not interested.
sentZh: 西蒙・哈里斯是副總理，也就是政府的副領導人。
他寫信給愛爾蘭和北愛爾蘭的所有政黨。
他請大家提出關於愛爾蘭統一的想法。
社會民主黨是南方第一個以書面回覆的政黨。
他們目前的領袖是基安・奧卡拉漢。
這個黨提出了四個想法。
其中一個想法是在愛爾蘭國會（Oireachtas）成立一個新的政治人物小組。
來自北愛爾蘭的議員也可以加入。
這個黨也希望民眾表達意見。
其他政黨的回應各不相同。
新芬黨和社會民主工黨喜歡這封信。
民主統一黨和阿爾斯特統一黨則不感興趣。

paragraphs: The Social Democrats have made four suggestions to help prepare for a united Ireland. They are in a letter to Tánaiste Simon Harris, who wrote to all parties in the Republic and Northern Ireland to ask for ideas.

The party's acting leader, Cian O'Callaghan, is the first leader of a southern party to reply in writing. The party wants a new Oireachtas committee to agree a plan for unity under the Good Friday Agreement. Members of the Northern Ireland Assembly would sit on it with TDs and senators.

The party also wants an all-island commission on social and economic questions, a Green Paper for the public to comment on, and a wider public discussion. Mr O'Callaghan said the work must look at health, housing, education and other services, not only money.
Reactions were mixed. Sinn Féin, the SDLP and Alliance welcomed the idea. The UUP said it was not interested, and the DUP leader, Gavin Robinson, criticised it.

該黨代理領袖基安・奧卡拉漢是第一位以書面回覆的南方政黨領袖。
該黨希望成立新的國會委員會，在《耶穌受難日協議》的架構下議定統一計畫。
北愛爾蘭議會的議員將與眾議員和參議員一同擔任委員。
該黨也希望設立一個處理社會和經濟問題的全島委員會、發表一份供民眾評論的綠皮書，並展開更廣泛的公共討論。
奧卡拉漢說，這項工作不能只看錢，還必須考慮醫療、住房、教育和其他服務。
各方反應不一。
新芬黨、社會民主工黨和聯盟黨歡迎這個想法。
阿爾斯特統一黨說不感興趣，民主統一黨領袖蓋文・羅賓森則提出批評。

paragraphs: The Social Democrats have put forward four proposals to advance work on Irish unity, in response to a letter from Tánaiste Simon Harris asking all parties on the island for their ideas. Acting leader Cian O'Callaghan is the first southern party leader to reply in writing.

The party is calling for a new Oireachtas committee to agree a framework for unity within the Good Friday Agreement, with members of the Northern Ireland Assembly sitting alongside TDs and senators. It also proposes an all-island social and economic commission, a Green Paper open to public consultation in both jurisdictions, and a broad civic discussion.

Mr O'Callaghan said any analysis must go beyond financial costs to include health, housing, education, childcare and energy. He argued that the Government's current proposals give the public no meaningful role.

The response from other parties was mixed. Sinn Féin and the SDLP welcomed the move, and Alliance said it would engage. However, the UUP said it had no interest, while DUP leader Gavin Robinson dismissed it as an attempt by Fine Gael to outflank its rivals.
